facts.title: BUG-0014: perceptible installed controller diagram acceptance
facts.blocking_evidence: Production launch of the real binary in a real window server shows a blank controller diagram area while test_manager_visual, test_overlay_visual, and test_golden pass. Goldens/pixel tests do not prove the production diagram rendering path. Required: a perceptible installed-diagram acceptance test on the installed X11 production path (recognizable diagram content, not a non-NULL texture, fallback, or broad pixel-count change).

facts.title: BUG-0015: real InputPlumber system-bus acceptance with four targets
facts.blocking_evidence: Manager reports 'Topology incomplete: 0 of 4 virtual controllers active' and no virtual controller works. inputplumber-system-dbus is NOT declared in .factory/environment.toml, so private/native-signature sd-bus tests are not real system-bus evidence. Required: four expected target/controller objects present and usable through production dispatch against the real org.shadowblip.InputPlumber system bus.

facts.title: Missing InputPlumber system-bus capability (inputplumber-system-dbus)
facts.blocking_evidence: inputplumber-system-dbus is undeclared in .factory/environment.toml with no tracked capability contract and no exact-commit receipt; no real org.shadowblip.InputPlumber bus owner/enumeration exists on the factory. Every row bound to this capability stays non-verified until a real system-bus probe receipt exists.

facts.title: Missing target consumer for real four-target routing and Pi 4 runtime
facts.blocking_evidence: target-consumer is undeclared in .factory/environment.toml. A uinput producer is not the target consumer: real four-target InputPlumber routing, aarch64/Pi 4 build and runtime, and Pi 4 latency measurement all require the real target consumer hardware. No receipt proves any of them.

facts.title: Missing GPU compositor backend evidence
facts.blocking_evidence: gpu-compositor is undeclared in .factory/environment.toml. test_backend_smoke exits 77 (skips) in headless; test_backend_smoke_sw provides software-renderer evidence only. Successful object creation or draw calls are insufficient for hardware-backend acceptance (SPEC §11.1.6).

facts.title: Missing target Pi runtime and human release acceptance
facts.blocking_evidence: The Pi 4 ≤75 ms p99 overlay appearance bound (§4.9, §11) is derived from poll+show computation, not measured on minimum supported hardware; and SPEC §11.1.7 human release acceptance requires a human reviewer on target hardware with captures and a criteria checklist. Neither the hardware measurement nor the human review artifact exists.
